# vextis docs

> Secure app config for local development and CI — organizations, apps, environments, and encrypted parameters, managed from a CLI.

## Start
- [Overview](https://docs.vextis.io/): What vextis is and where to start.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.vextis.io/quickstart): Get a local app running with managed config.
- [Install CLI](https://docs.vextis.io/install-cli): Install and update the vextis CLI.
- [CLI login](https://docs.vextis.io/cli-login): Authorize your terminal session.

## Core concepts
- [Organizations](https://docs.vextis.io/organizations): The root of every app, environment, and member.
- [Apps](https://docs.vextis.io/apps): Deployable services and projects.
- [Environments](https://docs.vextis.io/environments): Runtime targets like development and production.
- [Parameters](https://docs.vextis.io/parameters): Encrypted config keys and values.
- [Inheritance](https://docs.vextis.io/inheritance): Fallback behavior for unset values.

## CLI
- [CLI reference](https://docs.vextis.io/cli-reference): The full command surface.
- [Config commands](https://docs.vextis.io/config-commands): Pull, get, and set resolved config.
- [Linking a project](https://docs.vextis.io/linking-a-project): Bind a working tree to an app and environment.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.vextis.io/troubleshooting): Common setup and permission issues.

## Automate
- [Run with env](https://docs.vextis.io/run-with-env): Inject config into a child process.
- [CI/CD](https://docs.vextis.io/ci-cd): Use VEXTIS_TOKEN in automation.
- [Access tokens](https://docs.vextis.io/access-tokens): Personal and organization automation tokens.

## Security & governance
- [Security model](https://docs.vextis.io/security-model): Encryption, authorization, and audit posture.
- [Roles & permissions](https://docs.vextis.io/roles-permissions): System roles and the scope model behind them.
- [Audit logs](https://docs.vextis.io/audit-logs): Events recorded for sensitive actions.

## Reference
- [API basics](https://docs.vextis.io/api-basics): Auth model and key endpoints for automation.
- [SDKs](https://docs.vextis.io/sdks): SDKs planned after CLI and API stabilize. (not yet published)
- [Changelog](https://docs.vextis.io/changelog): CLI release notes.
